completionEvidence.description: While the guest remained running, a new QemuProvider instance with no process handles reconciled GetVmState through vm.json, process liveness and QMP query-status.
The reconciled state kept the original QEMU PID and running status; the follow-up StartVm did not create a duplicate process.

notes: Supervisor restart is represented by constructing a fresh provider instance against the same on-disk state, which exercises the actual recovery code path. A full vm-supervisor.exe process kill/restart test should be repeated when the HTTP lifecycle API is exposed.
